NSCameraUsageDescription: Autevo uses the camera so you can photograph the car you are selling.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Autevo needs your photo library so you can choose pictures of the car you are selling.
NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Autevo notifies you when a buyer replies, when a saved search finds a car, and before a listing expires.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Autevo connects to a development server on your network when it is built for testing.
